Notify.OutOfRange: {actor} is too far away from the pile.
Notify.BodyPart: "{item}" is part of the body and cannot be put down.
Notify.SlotGMOnly: Only the GM can assign inventory slots.
Notify.MysteryKeyTried: {actor} already tried the Mystery Key on this lock.
Notify.MysteryKeyFailed: "{key}" does not open the lock for {actor}.

Notify.DropCoinsFailed: The coins could not be dropped (see the console, F12).

Notify.NoCoinsHere: There are no coins here (any more).

enforceCapacity.Name: Enforce container capacity
enforceCapacity.Hint: Prevents storing items when the capacity (weight or count) of a container or one of its parent containers would be exceeded.

notifyLevel.Name: Notifications
notifyLevel.Hint:
Important only: warnings (e.g. no room, out of range) and declined or cancelled trades
All: also messages about picking up, auto-stowing, tidying, completed trades and new log entries
Applies to all players and the GM.

overfillMode.Name: On overfill
overfillMode.Hint: "Block" rejects storing the item. "Overfill with tear risk" allows it with a warning. Each time something is stored in an overfilled container it may tear, scattering all of its contents on the map around the token.

overfillHardLimit.Name: Maximum overfill (%)
overfillHardLimit.Hint: Beyond this percentage a container cannot be filled even in tear-risk mode. 0 = no limit.

tearChanceFactor.Name: Tear risk factor
tearChanceFactor.Hint: Tear chance in % = overfill in % × factor. With factor 1 a container overfilled by 25% tears with a 25% chance and always tears at 100% overfill or more.

enforceSlots.Name: Limit body slots
enforceSlots.Hint: Limits which and how many items may be carried directly in the inventory (outside of containers). Everything else must be stowed in containers.

slotActorTypes.Name: Slot limits apply to
slotActorTypes.Hint: Which actor types are affected by the body slot limits.

autoStow.Name: Auto-stow
autoStow.Hint: Items that may not be carried on the body are placed into the first container with enough room when added, instead of being rejected.

gmBypass.Name: Exempt the GM
gmBypass.Hint: The GM may ignore all limits.

fileLog.Name: Write the log
fileLog.Hint: Writes the activity log and the module's warnings and errors to the compendium "Pack & Ledger Logs". Only the GM can open it; it is read in the log window. Entries are only written while a GM is logged in. Players' warnings are sent to the GM.

logRetentionDays.Name: Keep the log (days)
logRetentionDays.Hint: Entries (activity and coins) older than this many days are deleted when the GM logs in. 0 keeps everything.

limitWeapon.Name: Max weapons on the body
limitWeapon.Hint: Number of weapons that may be carried directly. Each weapon counts, also within a stack (5 longswords are 5 weapons). Daggers are the exception: two daggers share a slot (1 or 2 daggers take 1 slot, 3 or 4 take 2).

limitArmor.Name: Max armor on the body
limitArmor.Hint: Equipment of type light, medium or heavy armor.

limitTool.Name: Max tools on the body
limitTool.Hint: Items of type "Tool" (thieves' tools, artisan's tools, instruments …).

limitBackpack.Name: Max backpacks on the body
limitBackpack.Hint: Any container not recognized as a jug.

limitJug.Name: Max jugs on the body
limitJug.Hint: Containers whose name matches the jug pattern.

limitTrinket.Name: Max trinkets on the body
limitTrinket.Hint: Small items on the body: rings, spellcasting focuses, holy symbols, potions, healer's kits etc.

limitTrinketWeight.Name: Trinket weight limit (lb)
limitTrinketWeight.Hint:
Only items lighter than this value (per unit) count as trinkets. Heavier ones must be stowed.
0 = no limit.

trinketEquipmentTypes.Name: Trinket: equipment types
trinketEquipmentTypes.Hint: Equipment types (dnd5e keys, separated by commas) that count as trinkets. Default: trinket, ring, rod, wand. Spellcasting focuses such as a crystal, orb, rod or wand have these types in dnd5e.

trinketConsumableTypes.Name: Trinket: consumable types
trinketConsumableTypes.Hint: Consumable types (separated by commas) that count as trinkets. Default: potion, trinket. This makes potions and the healer's kit count as trinkets.

trinketPattern.Name: Trinket: name pattern (regex)
trinketPattern.Hint: Items whose name matches this regular expression also count as trinkets regardless of type (e.g. Holy Symbol, Arcane Focus, Healer's Kit).

clothingPattern.Name: Clothing: name pattern (regex)
clothingPattern.Hint: Items whose name matches this regular expression count as clothing instead of trinkets. This applies even if they were imported e.g. as a consumable of type "trinket" (e.g. Robe, Vestments).

freePattern.Name: Free: name pattern (regex)
freePattern.Hint: Items whose name matches this regular expression take no slot and never need to be stowed. Natural weapons (type "Natural", e.g. Unarmed Strike, claws, bite) are always free.

bodyWeightEnabled.Name: Count body weight toward encumbrance
bodyWeightEnabled.Hint: A share of the body weight (biography field "Weight", e.g. "180 lb" or "82 kg") counts as weight already carried and reduces the room left before becoming encumbered.

bodyWeightPercent.Name: Body weight share (%)
bodyWeightPercent.Hint: Percentage of the body weight that counts toward the carried load. At 25% and 180 lb body weight, 45 lb count as carried.

jugPattern.Name: Jug pattern (regex)
jugPattern.Hint: Containers whose name matches this regular expression count as jugs instead of backpacks. Individual items can be overridden via right-click → "Set Inventory Slot".

pilesEnabled.Name: Drop items onto the map
pilesEnabled.Hint: Items dragged from a sheet onto the map land on the ground as a pile. Double-click a pile to open it.

pileRange.Name: Pile reach (squares)
pileRange.Hint: How far a token may be from a pile to take from it or drop something. 1 = adjacent. 0 = unlimited. Does not apply to the GM.

pileDeleteEmpty.Name: Remove empty piles
pileDeleteEmpty.Hint: Removes a pile from the map once its last item was taken.

pileMaskConsumables.Name: Hide potions and scrolls
pileMaskConsumables.Hint: Potions and scrolls the GM puts into a pile from the sidebar or a compendium appear to players as “Unknown potion” or “Unknown scroll” until the GM identifies them. What players drop from their inventory stays as it is.

tradeEnabled.Name: Trading between characters
tradeEnabled.Hint: Adds a Trade button below the player list. Both sides put items and coins into a trade window; once both accept, everything is swapped. The GM trades for NPCs without a player.

tradeRange.Name: Trade range (squares)
tradeRange.Hint: How far apart the trading partners' tokens may be at most. 1 = adjacent. 0 = no limit. Does not apply when the GM trades on both sides.

pilePassiveDiscovery.Name: Passive Perception finds piles
pilePassiveDiscovery.Hint: When a player character moves within reach of a hidden pile and their passive Perception meets the DC, the pile becomes visible. Active Perception checks always work.

pileDiscoveryRange.Name: Discovery range (squares)
pileDiscoveryRange.Hint: How close a character must be to a hidden pile to discover it. 0 = unlimited.

pileDiscoveryDC.Name: Default discovery DC
pileDiscoveryDC.Hint: Perception DC for hidden piles that have no DC of their own set in the pile window.

pileLockDC.Name: Default lock DC
pileLockDC.Hint: DC of the thieves' tools check for chests that have no DC of their own set in the pile window.

currencyAudit.Name: Log coin changes
currencyAudit.Hint: Writes every coin change of a player character to the coin log: who, when, how much, before and after. Coins from item piles, trades and invoices are included.

currencyAuditGM.Name: Include the GM's changes
currencyAuditGM.Hint: Also logs coin changes made by the GM. Off: only changes by players.

currencyAskReason.Name: Ask for a reason
currencyAskReason.Hint: After a player changes coins, asks the GM for the reason (reward, correction …). The answer is added to the log as an entry of its own.

currencySuspiciousCount.Name: Suspicious from
currencySuspiciousCount.Hint: This many changes by one player to the same character in a short time are flagged as suspicious (a warning in the log). 0 = never.

currencySuspiciousSeconds.Name: Time for suspicious changes
currencySuspiciousSeconds.Hint: The time in which the changes are counted.

currencyMath.Name: Sums with denominations
currencyMath.Hint: A sum in the coin fields of the character sheet may name another denomination, e.g. "-50 copper" in the gold field. "+10" and "-5" for the field itself are handled by dnd5e already.

currencyAutoConvert.Name: Make change automatically
currencyAutoConvert.Hint: When one denomination is not enough, other coins are used and change is given, as long as the purse is worth enough: 2 gp, "-5" in the silver field → 1 gp, 5 sp.

currencyPlatinum.Name: Change in platinum
currencyPlatinum.Hint: Change (coin fields and invoices) may be given in platinum. Off: gold, silver and copper.

currencyElectrum.Name: Change in electrum
currencyElectrum.Hint: Change may be given in electrum.

invoicesEnabled.Name: Invoices
invoicesEnabled.Hint: The GM can send invoices to player characters (button in the token controls and in the header of the character sheet). The player pays or declines.

trackerEnabled.Name: Track characters
trackerEnabled.Hint: Writes changes to the stored data of player characters (hit points, spell slots, resources, inventory, item uses …) with the value before and after to the log (filter "Characters"). Coins are in the coin log.

trackerHideGM.Name: Hide the GM's changes
trackerHideGM.Hint: Do not log changes made by GMs or assistants.

trackerAllOwned.Name: Track all player-owned characters
trackerAllOwned.Hint: All characters a player owns. Off: only the assigned player characters. Unlinked tokens count as characters of their own.

trackerConcentration.Name: Track concentration
trackerConcentration.Hint: Log concentration effects and include them in the snapshot comparison.

trackerSpells.Name: Track spells
trackerSpells.Hint: Names the spell a spell slot was spent on. When a spell that needs a slot is cast without one, the log shows a warning.

trackerPrivate.Name: Include confidential fields
trackerPrivate.Hint: Also log and restore the confidential fields. They may contain personal text.

trackerPrivateFields.Name: Confidential fields
trackerPrivateFields.Hint: Field paths that are left out, separated by commas, e.g. system.details.biography. Applies to sub-fields too.

provisionsEnabled.Name: Group provisions
provisionsEnabled.Hint: Shows the group's food and water (button in the token controls) and lets characters eat and drink from it during a long rest.

provisionsAuto.Name: Take automatically at a rest
provisionsAuto.Hint: Applies when a player starts a long rest on their own: whatever is missing is taken from the group's provisions without asking. Off: the player chooses in a dialog. At a rest the GM calls, the group shares out the meals together.

provisionsFoodPerDay.Name: Food per day
provisionsFoodPerDay.Hint: Rations a character needs a day.

provisionsWaterPerDay.Name: Water per day
provisionsWaterPerDay.Hint: Pints of water a character needs a day (a waterskin holds 4).

provisionsFoodPattern.Name: Food (name)
provisionsFoodPattern.Hint: Items whose name matches this regular expression count as food.

provisionsWaterPattern.Name: Water (name)
provisionsWaterPattern.Hint: Items whose name matches this regular expression count as water.

restEnabled.Name: Use the rest system
restEnabled.Hint: The GM calls rests with the button below the player list. At a long rest the characters eat and drink from the group's provisions.

restGMOnly.Name: Only the GM starts rests
restGMOnly.Hint: Players cannot rest on their own. Rests the GM calls and dnd5e's rest requests still work.

restAdvanceTime.Name: Let the time pass
restAdvanceTime.Hint: Default when calling a rest: the clock moves on by the length of the rest (depending on dnd5e's rest variant).

restMealsPropose.Name: Propose meals automatically
restMealsPropose.Hint: At a called long rest the module proposes a sharing of food and water right away. Off: the players share out themselves; the GM can have the module make a proposal when needed.

restExternalFood.Name: External food source
restExternalFood.Hint: How much of the day's food an external source gives when it is ticked at calling a rest. No items are used up.

restExternalWater.Name: External water source
restExternalWater.Hint: How much of the day's water an external source gives when it is ticked at calling a rest. No items are used up.

restExhaustion.Name: Exhaustion from hunger and thirst
restExhaustion.Hint: Characters short of food or water at a long rest become exhausted following the rules above.

restHalfWaterDC.Name: DC with half the water
restHalfWaterDC.Hint: DC of the Constitution save when a character drank only half of their water. 0 = no save and no exhaustion.

restNoFoodDays.Name: Days without food
restNoFoodDays.Hint: How many days a character can go without food before becoming exhausted. A formula using the character's data.

Pile.Name: Pile of items
Pile.TakerOutOfRange: {actor} is too far away. Move closer.
Pile.NoTaker: Select one of your tokens to take items.
Pile.DropHint: Drag items here or onto the map to drop them. Drag them from this window onto a character sheet to take them.
Pile.DropCoinsHere: Put coins of {actor} into this pile
Pile.DropCoinsBeside: Put coins on the ground next to the token
Pile.DropCoinsHint: How many coins should be put down?
Pile.CoinPileHint: After this, click the spot on the map where the pile should lie.
Pile.CoinPilePlace: Click on the map where the pile of coins should lie (right-click or Esc cancels).

Masked.PotionDescription: A small vial holding a liquid of unknown effect.
Masked.ScrollDescription: A rolled-up scroll, written in a script whose meaning is not clear.

provision.Title: Fed
provision.Summary: {actor} is fed from the group's provisions: {food} food, {water} water

Trade.Title: Trade: {actor} ⇄ {partner}
Trade.NoPartners: Nobody within reach that {actor} could trade with.
Trade.NoResponder: Nobody is around right now to trade for {partner}.
Trade.OutOfRange: {actor} and {partner} are too far apart to trade.
Trade.Expired: {partner} did not answer the trade request.
Trade.Blocked: The trade did not go through: {actor} cannot carry everything that was offered. Adjust the offers.
Trade.Changed: The trade did not go through because an offered item or the coins are no longer there. Check the offers.
Trade.Failed: Something went wrong while trading. Everything was reset.
Trade.Unavailable: This trade is no longer available.
Trade.NotYours: Only items of {actor} can be offered.
Trade.EmptyMine: Drag items from your inventory here or pick them below.
Trade.Hint: Once both sides accept, the trade happens. Any change to an offer withdraws both acceptances.
Trade.NoOwnActor: Select one of your tokens or assign a character to trade.
Trade.PlayerListHint: Trade with a character or NPC in range.

Config.Title: Pack & Ledger: Settings

Menu.Name: Module settings
Menu.Label: Open settings
Menu.Hint: All settings of the module, neatly grouped.

general.Name: General
general.Hint: Exemptions for the GM, notifications and the log.

containers.Name: Containers
containers.Hint: How much fits into backpacks, pouches and other containers, and what happens when they are overfilled.

slots.Name: Body slots
slots.Hint: What may be carried directly on the body. Everything else has to go into a container.

detection.Name: Detection
detection.Hint: How the module tells which slot an item belongs to.

map.Name: Map & Trade
map.Hint: Item piles on the map and trading between characters.

weight.Name: Body weight
weight.Hint: Count part of the character's own body weight towards the carried load.

currency.Name: Coins
currency.Hint: Log of coin changes, sums in the coin fields and invoices for the players.

tracker.Name: Characters
tracker.Hint: Track changes to player characters, save snapshots and restore them.

provisions.Name: Provisions
provisions.Hint: The group's food and water, stores such as a wagon, and eating at a long rest.

Section.LimitsHint: How many items of each kind may be carried directly on the body. Hover a tile for details.
Section.TestHint: Enter an item name to see which patterns match. The first match wins.
Section.SecretsHint: In the pile window, the GM can hide a pile or give it a lock (it is then shown as a chest).
Section.CoinInput: Coin fields on the character sheet
Section.CoinChangeHint: Which coins change is given in. Coins already in the purse are kept as far as possible.
Section.ProvisionsNeedHint: How much food and water a character needs each day.
Section.ProvisionsNamesHint: Consumables of type food with the subtype food, water or both are always recognized. Other items count when their name matches one of these patterns (regular expressions, ignoring case).
Section.ProvisionsRestHint: dnd5e handles the rest itself (hit points, hit dice, spell slots, uses). The module adds: the GM calls a rest for the group with the button below the player list. At a long rest the group shares out food and water together. At a short rest a button rolls hit dice automatically.
Section.ProvisionsExhaustionHint: Less than half the water gives one level of exhaustion, two levels for a character already exhausted. Exactly half calls for a Constitution save. Half a ration or less counts as half a day without food, nothing at all as a whole day. More days without food than allowed give exhaustion. A character short of food or water does not recover from exhaustion at that rest.

Config.ResetAllConfirm: Reset all settings in this window to their defaults? Nothing is stored until you click "Save".
Config.SaveFailed: The settings could not be saved (see the console for details).
Config.TestPlaceholder: e.g. Robe, Unarmed Strike, Potion of Healing …
Config.TestNone: No pattern matches. The slot follows from the item type.

Lock.LockedHint: Without the right key, the lock has to be picked.
Lock.OutOfRangeHint: Select one of your tokens within reach.
Lock.MysteryHint: Opens any lock with a small chance and then disappears. One try per lock.
Lock.MysteryTriedHint: This character already tried the key on this lock.
Lock.MysteryRollSuccess: {key} on "{pile}" ({chance} % chance): the lock clicks open and the key vanishes!
Lock.MysteryRollFail: {key} on "{pile}" ({chance} % chance): the key does not fit.

PileGM.Title: Game Master
PileGM.Hint: Empty DC fields use the defaults from the module settings. Hidden piles are found by Perception checks or by passive Perception within reach.
PileGM.Name: Name
PileGM.Identify: Identify (players then see the real name)
PileGM.Unidentify: Mark as unidentified (players only see the unidentified name)

Menu.Name: Log

LogApp.Disabled: Writing the log is turned off in the settings. New entries are not saved.

Remove.Kept: Some entries could not be deleted.

Input.ConvertOff: Not enough {coin}. Making change automatically is turned off.

Invoice.AddDraft: Start an invoice for this character
Invoice.Empty: Choose a character on the left to start an invoice.
Invoice.NoRecipient: No player of this character is online. The invoice can be prepared and sent later.
Invoice.NotePlaceholder: e.g. The Prancing Pony, two nights
Invoice.CostHint: Prices like 5 gp, 2 sp 5 cp, 3 gold 4 silver

Error.Cost: The price of "{name}" cannot be read. Examples: 5 gp, 2 sp 5 cp, 3 gold 4 silver.
Error.Offline: No player of {actor} is online right now.

Error.TooMany: At most {max} invoices at a time.

CoinLog.Csv: Save the shown entries as CSV

CoinLog.DeleteDayHint: Delete every entry of the coin log of {day} for good? This cannot be undone.

Tracker.Title: Character tracker
Tracker.NoSnapshot: There is no snapshot of this character yet.
Tracker.SnapshotInvalid: The snapshot does not fit this character (other system or type).
Tracker.ConfirmSaveAll: Save new snapshots for all tracked characters, including unlinked tokens? Existing ones are overwritten.
Tracker.ConfirmRestore: Restore the selected data from the snapshot? The current values are overwritten; this cannot be undone automatically.
Tracker.Failed: Character tracker: the action failed. See the log for details.

Spell.NoSlot: {spell} (level {level}) was cast without spending a spell slot.
Spell.Ritual: The spell is a ritual and may have been cast as one.

LogTab.Title: Pack & Ledger
LogTab.Empty: No entries in the last 24 hours.

Provisions.Title: Group inventory
Provisions.Opened: One of them is opened: {part} of it is used up already.
Provisions.Empty: No player characters and no stores found.
Provisions.NeedPerDay: The group needs per day: {food} food, {water} water.

Store.Add: Mark as a store of the group
Store.Remove: No longer a store of the group
Store.Added: “{actor}” is now a store of the group.
Store.Removed: “{actor}” is no longer a store of the group.

Rest.Title: From the group's provisions
Rest.NoGM: The group's provisions need a GM to be logged in.
Rest.Nothing: There is none of it left in the group's provisions.
Rest.NotEnough: The group's provisions are not quite enough.
Rest.Failed: Nothing could be taken from the group's provisions. Details are in the browser console.
Rest.GMOnly: Rests are called by the GM.
Rest.Starving: Days without food: {days}. Exhausted from hunger.
Rest.Thirst: Less than half the water: {levels} level(s) of exhaustion.
Rest.ThirstSaved: Only half the water: Constitution save made.
Rest.ThirstFailed: Only half the water: Constitution save failed, {levels} level(s) of exhaustion.
Rest.GMOption: Set by the GM when calling the rest.
Rest.Before: Had before the rest: {food} food, {water} water

Provisions.AddResource: Drop an item here to track it
Provisions.ResourceAdded: “{item}” is now tracked in the group provisions.
Provisions.ResourceExists: “{item}” is tracked already (or counts as food or water).
Provisions.OverviewNone: No daily need is set for food and water.

Refill.Hint: Refills all empty and partly used waterskins of the characters and of the stores with the group.
Refill.AllFull: All waterskins of the group are full.

Provisions.NoStores: The group has no store yet. The GM marks an actor (a wagon, a camp chest …) as a store with the button in its sheet's header.

Magic.Note: Magic sources each day: {jugs}× Alchemy Jug, {tankards}× Tankard of Plenty. Already counted in the days above.
Magic.JugHint: Alchemy Jug: each day either half a ration for up to {food} people (never a full ration) or water for up to {water} people (4 pints each, a whole day).
Magic.TankardHint: Tankard of Plenty: each day water for up to {water} people (4 pints each, a whole day).

Provisions.StoreLocked: “{actor}” is not with the group: you can look into it, but not take anything out or put anything in.

CallRest.Title: Call a rest for the group
CallRest.SupplyHint: A jug gives food or water for the whole day.
CallRest.NewDayHint: Uses that recharge at dawn, at dusk or on a new day are recovered. Alchemy Jugs and Tankards of Plenty give again.
CallRest.RecoverMaxHint: Removes any adjustments to the character's maximum hit points.
CallRest.Hint: Call a short or long rest for the group.
CallRest.ExternalHint: Gives food or water without using up items. How much is set in the module settings.
CallRest.AbsentHint: The character is not with the group: it does not rest, and its provisions and magic items are not there for the others at this rest.

Session.Title: Meals at the rest
Session.Hint: Share out together who gets which food and water: with "Add source" you choose for each character what it eats and drinks.
Session.Absent: Not with the group (their provisions do not count): {names}
Session.HintGM: No player takes part. Share out the food and water and start the rest.
Session.Half: Only half: a Constitution save (water) or half a day without food
Session.RowShort: Only {amount} of it: not enough is left, or this source is not allowed.
Session.ProposeHint: The module proposes a sharing and replaces the current one. Everyone has to agree again afterwards.
Session.ForceHint: Starts the rest now, even if not everyone has agreed.
Session.ForceConfirm: Not everyone has agreed yet: {names}. Start the rest anyway?
Session.StartHint: Hand out the food and water and start the rest.
Session.Running: The meals are handed out, the rest begins …
Session.Failed: The change could not be sent to the GM.
Session.NoSource: There is no further source for that.
Session.Open: Share out the meals at the rest
Session.CarryFailed: Not all meals of the rest could be handed out. Check the inventories (details in the log).
Session.StartFailed: The rests could not all be started. Check the characters (details in the log).
Session.Interrupted: A rest was interrupted while the meals were handed out, because the page was reloaded. It has been ended. Check the inventories and call the rest again if needed.
Session.Replace: The meals of another rest are still being shared out. Cancel that rest and call a new one?
Session.CancelStuck: If this takes too long, this ends the rest without handing out anything more.
